technique_name: Write one paragraph (5-7 sentences) about the impact of digital media on education.
description: Digital media has had a huge impact on education in recent years. Technology such as the internet and computers have allowed people to access vast amounts of educational material from all around the world, enabling students to explore a variety of subjects. Digital media also has enabled a new era of collaboration, with students being able to connect with one another and share their ideas even if they’re geographically distant.
